title: git-test-repositories says which git commands refuse a branch held through a rebase's update-refs, and with which error
goal: The fact at kb/public/gitlab/git-test-repositories.md on update-refs holders is split in two: die_if_checked_out (checkout, switch, rebase, worktree add) knows HEAD, a detached rebase and bisect, whereas update-refs blocks branch -f and new-branch validation only, with its own error text

run: import re,sys;t=open('kb/public/gitlab/git-test-repositories.md',encoding='utf-8').read();ps=re.split(r'\n(?=- )',t);ok=any('update-refs' in p and re.search(r'branch (-f|--force)',p) for p in ps);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import re,sys;t=open('kb/public/gitlab/git-test-repositories.md',encoding='utf-8').read();ps=re.split(r'\n(?=- )',t);ok=any('update-refs' in p and 'die_if_checked_out' in re.sub(r'\[[^\]]*\]','',p) and 'bisect' in p for p in ps);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

gates.question: Which facts besides the two the goal names go into the split: placement of checkout -B and worktree add -B against the two checks?
